name: metis-mcp
description: Registers the Métis MCP server. Seven read-only tools: list_workflows, route_request, get_model, validate_model, coverage, run_status and why_read_only. Read-only by construction (§9.5, N-8) — no decision may be taken through this surface, so landing, approval and publication go through the CLI, where the gates are. Requires a running Métis server and a Neo4j graph.
